latestVersion.verdictComment: **Catastrophe deepens: 38 critical regressions (+4 NEW 2026-05-18).** Duplicate session poisoning, MiniMax auth stall, Docker image incomplete, image vision timeout. Five days of continuous failures across 21 subsystems.
